name: On-U Sound
ownershipStory: Founded by Adrian Sherwood and Pete Holdsworth as a vehicle for Sherwood's own dub-derived productions, rotating a loose collective of Jamaican session players and British post-punk and industrial musicians through albums credited to a shifting set of project names (African Head Charge, Tackhead, and others) rather than a single fixed band.
hook: Adrian Sherwood's own label, built to release dub technique carried into British post-punk and industrial music.

blurb.age7: This is Adrian Sherwood's own record label in London, where he put out his echoey, dub-style music.
blurb.age13: On-U Sound is Adrian Sherwood's own label, started in London in 1979 to release his dub-influenced productions, credited to a rotating cast of project names rather than one fixed band.
blurb.adult: On-U Sound functioned less like a conventional label and more like a production house: Sherwood's own vehicle for applying King Tubby- and Lee Perry-style dub technique to a shifting group of collaborators across three decades.
